data.name: Aabidah
data.gender_notes: Aabidah is used as a female name in Arabic and Urdu naming tradition.
data.short_meaning: Female worshipper; devout woman; she who worships
data.long_meaning: Aabidah (عابدة) is an Arabic name meaning “Female worshipper; devout woman; she who worships”. It is the feminine of Arabic ʿābid (عابد) 'worshipper', from the root ʿ-b-d 'to worship'. The name denotes a woman devoted to worship. Aabidah, Aabida and Aabidaah are three transliterations of the same Arabic name.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aabidah carries the meaning Female worshipper; devout woman. The name expresses devotion; this is its documented lexical sense rather than an added doctrinal claim.
data.etymology: Feminine of Arabic ʿābid (عابد) 'worshipper', from the root ʿ-b-d.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabidah total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner wisdom. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What does the name Aabidah mean?
faq.a: Aabidah means Female worshipper; devout woman; she who worships.

faq.q: What is the origin of the name Aabidah?
What language does the name Aabidah come from?
faq.a: Aabidah is used in Arabic and Urdu.

faq.q: Is Aabidah a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aabidah is used as a female name.

faq.q: How is Aabidah written in Arabic?
faq.a: Aabidah is written عابدة in Arabic, عابدہ in Urdu and आबिदा in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aabidah?
faq.a: The root of Aabidah is ʿ-b-d (ع-ب-د), from ʿābidah (عابدة).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aabidah?
faq.a: Aabidah is the feminine of Arabic ʿābid (عابد), worshipper, from the root ʿ-b-d, to worship.

faq.q: Does Aabidah appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aabidah is not itself a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: What is the masculine form of Aabidah?
faq.a: The masculine form is ʿĀbid (عابد), a male worshipper, listed in this dataset as Aabid.

faq.q: Is Aabidah the same name as Aabida?
faq.a: Yes. Aabidah, Aabida and Aabidaah are all transliterations of the same Arabic name ʿābidah (عابدة). The final -h is silent in pronunciation.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aabidah verified?
faq.a: Yes. The meaning Female worshipper rests on the Arabic feminine active participle ʿābidah, from ʿ-b-d.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aabidah?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabidah total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is traditionally associated with reflection, analysis and inner wisdom. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aabidah?
faq.a: Variants and alternative transliterations include Abida, Aabida, Abidah and Aabidaah.

faq.q: Where is the name Aabidah used today?
faq.a: Aabidah circulates chiefly in Arabic and Urdu naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it.
